tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Search Karandeep Singh's blog (DevOps/AWS articles and cheatsheets). Returns ranked cards with title, URL, tags, date, reading time, and summary.

tools.name: read_post
tools.description: Read a post's full text by URL, paginated. Returns a window of characters; call again with the returned next offset to continue.

tools.name: list_recent
tools.description: List the most recently published posts.

tools.name: browse_by_tag
tools.description: List posts with a given tag (e.g. aws, lambda, cost, aurora). Use list_topics to see all tags.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List every tag on the blog with a post count, for discovering what's covered.

tools.name: related_posts
tools.description: Given a post URL, find other posts that share the most tags with it.

tools.name: random_post
tools.description: Return a random post from the blog — a surprise pick.

tools.name: get_cheatsheet
tools.description: Jump straight to a cheatsheet by topic (docker, cloudformation, cost, aurora, kubernetes, …) and get its full text.

tools.name: list_cheatsheets
tools.description: List all cheatsheets (quick-reference guides) on the blog.

tools.name: quiz_me
tools.description: Test the user's knowledge with real multiple-choice questions written for the blog's articles. Returns questions, options, and an answers section with explanations. Ask the questions first, then reveal the answers.

tools.name: get_commands
tools.description: Return just the runnable commands and code blocks from the best-matching article or cheatsheet — no prose. Use when the user wants the command, not the explanation.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_posts, read_post, list_recent, browse_by_tag, list_topics · Public sink: read_post, list_topics, related_posts, random_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_posts, read_post, list_recent, browse_by_tag, list_topics · Public sink: read_post, list_topics, related_posts, random_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
